name: ConfirmRebirthDialog
description: Confirms a Sparkplug rebirth request for one or more edge nodes before any NCMD is published.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: A boolean store, matching Dialog's open-state contract.

props.name: targets
props.description: The {group, node} edge nodes that will be asked to rebirth. More than one switches to the bulk wording and a list of up to 10.

props.name: busy
props.description: True while the requests are in flight. Both buttons disable and the dialog does not close until the parent closes it.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called on confirm; returns a promise. The parent closes isOpen once it resolves.

notes: Figma is not linked yet. Mirrors ConfirmClearRetainedDialog: both publish something every other client on the broker sees.
